title: Uffington White Horse and St George's Dragon Mound

tellings.quote: mound right next to the Uffington white horse known as St. George and the Dragon's Mound, which is the spot where St. George slayed the dragon, right?

plain: Right next to the Uffington White Horse, an ancient giant horse figure on a hillside in England, there is a mound known as St George and the Dragon's Mound, said by local legend to be the spot where St George killed the dragon. A guest named Geoffrey Drumm points this out on the show, without naming a source, as part of his own ideas about ancient sites.
